purpose: Design-support calibration only. Identify baseline-policy synthetic regimes spanning weak/moderate/resilient insurgent persistence before any policy ranking.

design.resource_multiplier_definition: Multiply initial INSURGENT liquid capital and annual external support by this factor immediately after world initialization and before any event executes.

persistence_definition: Live reproductive insurgency at day360 iff rooted_armed_membership_mass > 0, recruitment_hazard_mass > 0, and fielded_force_personnel > 0.

selection_rule.weak: Cell whose day360 live-reproductive fraction is closest to 0.25.
selection_rule.moderate: Cell whose day360 live-reproductive fraction is closest to 0.50.
selection_rule.strong: Cell whose day360 live-reproductive fraction is closest to 0.75; if multiple tie, choose higher median rooted membership.

firewall: Only baseline policy is run in calibration.
No government strategy comparison is permitted on this seed block.
Selected challenge cells must be carried unchanged to a fresh policy-evaluation seed block.
guard: Synthetic support calibration only; challenge multipliers are not empirical conflict estimates.
